nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
# General Enhancement

> ⚠️ **R&D workflow.** Under active development and testing. Not production-ready: expect changes to nodes, defaults and models.

**Stages (toggles)**
1. **General Enhancement** (default on): SD1.5 epiCRealism refine per 900 px tile, with Qwen3-VL tile captions.
2. **Advance Details** (off): 1x-ReFocus sharpen blend + Flux (Fluxmania) pass per tile.
3. **Body & Face Enhancement** (off): FaceDetailer for people, then faces.

Stages 1–2 run inside the cropped area and are blended back.
If both are off, the original image goes straight to Stage 3 or to the output.

**Mask:** paint in the Load Image **Mask Editor** and enable `Use Painted Mask` to limit stages 1–2 to that area.

Disabled stages are skipped at run time by lazy **Switch** nodes. Every combination of toggles is valid.
